creatures.desc: Less of a bird and more of an odd flying arthropod most of these interesting creatures are less dangerous than they might first appear. High in the upper atmosphere of many planets the hard shelled bodies of these creatures float gracefully on their five pairs of wings. They have long tendrils that hang below the clouds they live in, around 30-60 ft. long, these tendrils carry paralytic venom and are mostly used to ensnare small birds and other flyers.

traits.name: Bite
traits.effect: +2 Attack Bid

traits.effect: +2 To Applicable Skill Bid

creatures.desc: These Aerial Creatures are not truly snakes, but share a strong resemblance because of their lack of limbs.They lack fangs of any kind and are non venomous, but this is not to say that a bite from one is harmless. The inside of their mouths and throats have rough pallets covered in razor sharp bristles that shred whatever they bite down on.They are mostly scavengers and their main source of food are bird eggs. They come in a variety of colors, with the males being mostly muted blue and green and the females being dark red with green or blue highlights.

creatures.desc: These amazing creatures start life as a feathered serpent-like creature which lives in fields and light forests. Halfway through its life it will build a cocoon out of a hard mucus it can regurgitate and begin its metamorphosis into a large colorful bird.They are most common in warmer climates. After its change the Caterpillar Bird will fly to a large forest and only return to the fields to lay eggs.

creatures.desc: A brightly colored variety of frog which has particularly elastic skin. They will inflate to massive sizes to scare off predators and to occasionally escape.

creatures.desc: A large deer like creature with antlers which continue to grow as long as the creature does. The older ones tend to have colonies of creatures living in the antlers which often resemble fallen trees.

These patterns can often identify what region a creature came from. They produce silk which was used early on but is difficult to refine and collect.

Its large feathers resemble the leaves of many trees in the area, providing refuge from the heat for other creatures.The creatures often attract the birds prey which it handily consumes and protects them from.

creatures.desc: These reptiles reside deep underground near caverns with lava flows and inside of volcanoes.Caliculas are rarely encountered by humans due to their habitat being a danger in and of itself. They mostly eat large crustaceans and worms that live in these same caverns, but will be aggressive to almost anything it comes across.Their Extreme body temperature means those they bit will also suffer severe burns.

creatures.desc: With an acute sense of location these birds have found their way into a number of activities across many cities.Early on the birds were used as a poor man's compass, guiding individuals between villages and areas. Nowadays they deliver items, materials, and messages across cities. The birds are getting larger to accommodate higher weight objects over the years.

creatures.desc: Squirrels naturally had long acted as a pest to many homes and villages early on. The trouble they caused often led to individuals conjuring up different ways to stop the menaces. The wayward spells of some would lead to a unique population of squirrels which grew the very crops they used to consume.Nowadays, many are kept as pets and used as an easy to maintain year round crop. Some pedigree breeds have gained. More unsavory traits as they have been bred with more and more unique crops.

Their dark fur can subtly change color to help them blend into the nightscape of cities.While usually only considered pests, large packs can certainly be dangerous even to groups of people. Experienced Juxpuer tend to be well versed in magic, and are often the leaders of packs.

These ooze like creatures come in a variety of sizes and are frequent in places where there is runoff, sewage or garbage. You can find them solitary or as large colonies which have combined into a larger entity.
